$comment: Continuous sounds of the active vessel's environment. aero: boundary-layer wind (level 20 log10(q / qRef) dB, brightness from Mach) and transonic buffet (Gaussian in Mach around machCenter, modulated rumble). reentry: shock-layer roar and plasma hiss from aero.plasmaIntensity, a buffet rumble that also follows the g-load. Both are airborne for an outside listener and hull-borne (low-passed at hullCutoffHz) inside the cabin. cabin: interior ambience (fans, pumps, airflow, 400 Hz power hum) heard only by an interior listener, and structural creaks whose Poisson rate follows g-load, its rate of change and sunlight changes (thermal creaks); creaks use a seeded generator so renders are reproducible.
